id: title:MattPua:add insights without replacing dashboard tiles

review.posthog_relevance: Adds HogAI assistant capability to add insights while preserving existing dashboard tiles.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F3.H4 and P1.F3.H5 adds action handlers and response formatting for HogAI assistant, allowing it to add insights without removing existing ones. This is a bounded, substantive capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of shared-dashboard access enforcement; P1.F3.H6 is missing. The tier is assigned based on the observed HogAI changes, not the missing enforcement. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the shared-dashboard access enforcement.
